in_marathi.name: Vishvik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishvik is a Sanskrit name meaning 'All-pervading'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Vish' meaning 'all' and 'Vik' meaning 'pervading'. This name is often used to describe a deity who is present everywhere and in all things.
